name: Aureve
source:
An older model robot who is humanoid in appearance. She is both sentient and sapient.

Likes: Weaving, roses, nature in general, drawing
Dislikes: Feeling uncertain, doing nothing, being around too many people

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chouette/belle-automata]Kickstarter[/url]]
